title: Quantum State Preparation with the QNN-based SRBB Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2503.13647v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, a novel algorithm structured on Lie algebras for the approximate quantum state preparation problem is proposed, addressing a challenge of fundamental importance in many areas of quantum computing. The algorithm uses a variational quantum circuit designed on the Standard Recursive Block Basis (SRBB), a hierarchical construction for the matrix algebra of the $SU(2^n)$ group, which is capable of linking the variational parameters with the topology of the Lie group. Compared to the full algebra, using only diagonal components reduces the number of CNOTs by an exponential factor, as well as the circuit depth, in full agreement with the relaxation principle inherent to the approximation methodology of minimizing resources while achieving high accuracy. translated_title: 基于量子神经网络的SRBB算法的量子态制备
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，提出了一种基于李代数的新型算法，用于解决近似量子态制备问题，这是量子计算许多领域中一个具有根本重要性的挑战。该算法使用一种在标准递归块基（SRBB）上设计的变分量子电路，SRBB是$SU(2^n)$群矩阵代数的一种分层结构，能够将变分参数与李群的拓扑结构联系起来。与完整代数相比，仅使用对角分量可使CNOT门数量减少指数倍，同时也降低了电路深度，这与近似方法中固有的松弛原则完全一致，即在实现高精度的同时最小化资源消耗。随后，通过一种基于对角SRBB子代数设计的新型量子神经网络来近似目标量子态。这种方法提供了一种新的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于李代数的SRBB算法，利用标准递归块基将变分参数与李群拓扑结构联系起来，并通过对角分量结合新型量子神经网络，实现指数级减少CNOT门数量和电路深度的同时保持高精度的近似量子态制备。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a QNN-based SRBB algorithm built on Lie algebras, which links variational parameters to Lie group topology through the Standard Recursive Block Basis and uses only diagonal components to exponentially reduce CNOT gates and circuit depth while achieving high-accuracy approximate quantum state preparation.
